title: Seedance 2.5 will change how people make videos #shorts
description:
This is gonna completely change how people make videos in the future.

It’s the all-new Seedance 2.5 model in OpenArt.

And this allows you to do something creatively, you were never able to do before.

Seedance 2.5 can generate up to 30 second long cinematic videos in a single shot.

Like all these visuals you’ve been watching were all from one continuous generation.

And all of the sound design was also generated with it automatically.

Now this might not seem like a big deal, but it is a huge unlock for professional creatives.

You can now film commercials, product shoots, and any cinematic sequence with full consistency end to end.

The lighting is better, the camera movement is way smoother, and very underrated, the facial expressions are much more realistic.

Now with these model releases, sometimes it can be difficult to spot the improvements, but this is by far the cutting edge frontier for video generation.

If you want to try this out in OpenArt, they’re offering unlimited Seedance 2.5 generations on their Wonder plan: https://bit.ly/kallawayopenart
